name: Family Reunification Residence Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Zakon o tujcih (ZTuj-2), Article 47: the sponsoring resident must have held Slovenian temporary residence for at least 1 year (time on a pending application counts) before initiating family reunification for a spouse/registered partner, unmarried minor children (including a partner's), or -- narrowly -- parents or adult dependent children/parents needing support under home-country law. The sponsor must show sufficient means for themselves and all family members for the prior 6 months plus the application month, measured against Slovenia's social-assistance scale (e.g. a spouse weighted at 0.57, a child at 0.59 of the basic amount). Family members' permits run for the sponsor's permit duration, capped at 2 years initially and 3 years per extension. Adult family members must demonstrate survival-level Slovene at extension, with limited exceptions (students, over-60s, certain employment categories).
requirements.fix_path: As a temporary resident of at least 1 year, document sufficient means against the social-assistance scale and apply for family reunification for the qualifying relative.

evidence_required.document: Marriage/partnership certificate or proof of filiation
Proof of sufficient financial means (social-assistance-scale calculation)
Survival-level Slovene language proof (adult members, at extension)

outcome.duration_length: matches sponsor's permit, capped at 2 years initially, 3 years per extension
outcome.physical_presence_requirement: sponsor must hold 1 year of prior temporary residence
